classic.catalogued_text: Delay estimation; rate adjustment; drift compensation

assets: Historical local AEC Challenge train-only audio and per-file manifests (ignored workspace data, not redistributed).
Installed pywebrtc-audio 0.2.0 binding, local SpeexDSP library and compact LocalVQE weights from the cited pilots.
AECMOS v4 ONNX weights used as a learned metric, not as a delay estimator.
comparison_inputs: Paired 16 kHz mono far-end render and microphone capture, 12 synthetic train scenarios from the AEC Challenge source revision 8f861f0f8ffca26a3d1d16f17f2594ea89abe7ac.
12 recorded device groups from the same challenge training tree (108 files); no blind test audio.
Offline paired clean/noisy scoring replay with independently measured content lag; kept separate from render/capture pilots.
controls: Declared render/capture rate and channel layout; misaligned inputs are rejected rather than silently trimmed.
Known content offsets: AEC3 125–128 samples (~8 ms), LocalVQE one 256-sample hop (16 ms), 0/20/40 ms stream-delay-hint pilot.
Fixed 128-sample AEC3 scoring offset and separately reported model offsets; no adaptive clock tracking was run.
limits: These are fixed offsets on historical local pilots. No component measures or compensates live capture-clock drift in these records.
AEC Challenge training data are not cleared for redistribution or acceptance; no audio is added by this survey.

local_outcomes.finding: AEC3 content alignment was measured at 125–128 samples (about 8 ms) on clean near-only trials; the real pilot removed a known 8 ms offset before scoring.
A stream-delay-hint pilot (0, 20, 40 ms) showed little near-end change; 0 ms remained the default pending recordings with known capture/playback buffer delay.

reported_outcomes.finding: S27 names the WebRTC processing interface; the registry does not pin an upstream drift or alignment result.

assets: Task-local proposal fixtures only (typed-frame and duplex-clocks directories); no weights, corpora or recordings are introduced.
comparison_inputs: Exact integer source sample indices, declared source rates (48/32/16 kHz) and an explicit target rate; no audio media.
Declared integer ppm drift, half-open sample intervals and one monotonic clock domain.
controls: Exact rational 48 kHz→16 kHz impulse mapping; explicit selection required; missing rate/channel/format selection is rejected.
Duplicate/stale timestamps, gaps, overlaps, missing roles, nonfinite input and drift beyond the declared bound are rejected as distinct states.
Bounded drain and finite tail accounted as non-content; concealment never satisfies conservation.
limits: Both clock fixtures are proposal-only and outside the fixed v0 ABI; no native build, installed provider or paced device workload was run for them here.
This survey does not implement or enable rate conversion, resampling, buffering or time-scale control.

local_outcomes.finding: Typed-frame proposal reports content delay D=173 samples measured by a source-coordinate impulse, with absolute drift bounded at 10000 ppm; it is a developer-tool model, not an SDK provider.
Duplex-clocks proposal maps a declared +6250 ppm capture drift and rejects gaps, overlaps and missing roles; the fixture explicitly does not supply live clock-drift evidence.

reported_outcomes.finding: S41 documentation supplies a time-scale/rate-adjustment lead; no local NetEq time-scale experiment is recorded here.
Buffer occupancy is a control law, not an estimator; catch-up/slow-down timing belongs to the rate and playout boundary.

assets: Historical macOS host toolchain and simulated AudioUnit callback path; no microphone access and no written audio in the cited self-test.
No new asset, device entitlement or provider registration is introduced by this survey.
comparison_inputs: CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW worker timestamps and CoreAudio Mach absolute host timestamps on the historical macOS host.
Synthetic 48 kHz/480-sample callback frames split across 160- and 320-sample invocations; no opened audio device.
Declared sample-coordinate ppm maps from the two proposal fixtures.
controls: Setup-time Mach-to-raw offset bracket with bounded arithmetic and carried calibration uncertainty; calibration failure aborts before streaming.
Simulated callback topology checks and 160/320-sample frame split; host-only CTest coverage, not a device test.
Explicit missing-reference state and rejected stale/future/sample-offset/uncertainty mismatch in the provisional render-reference path.
limits: No live drift tracking, suspend/restart recovery, device clock recovery or blind-set result exists in the reviewed pins.
M2 render-reference work in the historical record remained capability-discovery disabled and is not a public SDK capability.

local_outcomes.finding: The clock-domain audit calibrated a Mach-to-raw offset and carried interval uncertainty; the offset is not refreshed after suspend or restart, and clock discontinuity during a run is not qualified.
The AudioUnit self-test exercised a 160/320-sample frame split in simulation; no physical AudioUnit or CoreAudio device callback evidence was available.

reported_outcomes.finding: The composition report states that delay contracts are implementation-specific and that matched AEC results lack live clock-drift and target-device evidence.

ml.catalogued_text: Learned estimation is optional research, not required
findings: The registry audits an ML family but marks learned estimation optional. No catalogued component implements a learned delay/clock-drift estimator for ENG-02.
CAGCRN is cited in AEC research for delay alignment and requires paired reference input; only a paper lead and compatibility work are recorded, not a local drift run.
AECMOS is a learned, scenario-aware metric applied after known 8/16 ms content offsets are removed; it is not a learned alignment or drift estimator.
missing_evidence: No pinned ML source revision, runnable checkpoint or matched render/capture cohort for clock-drift estimation.
No drift-labeled target, independent holdout or uncertainty result; background AEC papers are citations, not local executions.
The legacy backlog records ENG-02/F16 as catalogued with next action 'Plan discovery across required source buckets'; it does not authorize a learned implementation.

historical_executions: WebRTC AEC3 12-scenario synthetic training pilot: measured 125–128-sample (~8 ms) content alignment, fixed 128-sample scoring offset.
WebRTC AEC3 real training pilot: known 8 ms content offset removed before AECMOS scoring; no capture-clock-drift measurement.
Recorded-real hybrid AEC loader trims far-end/capture to common sample count and applies no extra delay compensation.
limits: The registry records a direct URL without a pinned revision or a local checkout; it is a source lead, not local source evidence.
Measured content alignment is an offline scoring offset, not sample-clock tracking, device latency or synchronization qualification.
